svg.title: Query agent safeguards — enforced checks and remaining limits
svg.desc: Four panels distinguish code-enforced request and SQL checks, bounded execution and failure behavior, prompt-guided behavior, and data/privacy limitations. Inputs and history are validated, MCP is isolated by per-turn IDs, generated SQL is rechecked and executed unchanged in read-only transactions, and duplicate work is memoized. Six loop model calls exclude generation and summary. WebSocket turns and MCP calls have separate 180-second limits, while database statement and lock timeouts are 10 and 3 seconds. History and results are bounded, cancellation is cooperative, and model providers receive unredacted loaded rows. Read-only checks do not provide authentication, per-user authorization, or a general function sandbox.

span.p: 4. Answer and data boundaries — limits remain
3. Work and failure limits — enforced in code
2. SQL and database checks — enforced in code
1. Request and MCP checks — enforced in code

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: WebSocket question: 1–10,000 characters. History: alternating user/assistant pairs; at most 40 messages and 120,000 characters

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: MCP schemas validate inputs and outputs. Application adds a UUID; each call resolves only its active turn context

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Credentials and callbacks stay on the server. Shared MCP connection uses in-memory transport; context deleted in finally

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Accept one SELECT-based query with recognized table references. Allow SELECT CTEs; check connected-schema table allow-list

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Reject writes, DDL, write CTEs, SELECT INTO, row locks, and multiple statements. Execution must match saved validated SQL

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Database rechecks policy; READ ONLY transaction; fixed search path. Statement timeout: 10 seconds; lock timeout: 3 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: At most 6 agent-loop model calls; generation and summary calls are extra. Stop after execution or a tool failure

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Reuse per-turn operation promises, including failures; no automatic provider retry. Query failure ends turn; summary-only failure keeps table + warning

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: WebSocket turn: 180 seconds; each MCP call: 180 seconds. Cancel signals propagate; active SQL may run until completion or DB timeout

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Prompt guidance: clarify ambiguity; treat history and rows as data; answer only from available facts. Model compliance and correctness are not guaranteed

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: At most 1,000 loaded rows per query; count is not total matches. Retained history keeps all rows, dropping whole turns to fit; older facts may be missing

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: Real AI receives questions, schema, and loaded rows without redaction. Public demo has no login or per-user policy; DB role controls table/function access
